family.scope: all retained non-stimulation contacts per pair and configuration; finite p_joint

normalization.operation: per-trial nanmedian; half-open rounded sample slice

seed_policy.algorithm: SHA256 UTF-8 namespace|subject|pair|channel; first 8 bytes big-endian; mask to 63 bits
seed_policy.configuration_sharing: same channel seed in both configurations; overrides config random_state

comparison.scope_limit: One public pair with eight trials; does not assert a fresh execution of every public pair.

covered_failures: changed response window with same configuration name
incomplete grid with updated CSV hash
interruption between CSV and receipt publication
frozen restoration combined with detector stage
